#![allow(unused, non_snake_case, non_camel_case_types, unreachable_patterns, unreachable_code, clippy::all)]

use super::types;

/// Error returned by procs.
pub type Error = Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>;

/// The node that failed, wrapping its implementation's error.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NodeError {
    pub node: &'static str,
    pub source: Error,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for NodeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}: {}", self.node, self.source)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NodeError {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {
        Some(&*self.source)
    }
}

fn wrap(node: &'static str, source: Error) -> Error {
    Box::new(NodeError { node, source })
}

/// A failure as a program prints it: the error underneath the nodes, and
/// (when it passed through more than one) the nodes, outermost first.
pub fn describe_error(e: &Error) -> String {
    let mut nodes = vec![];
    let mut cur: &(dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync + 'static) = &**e;
    while let Some(n) = cur.downcast_ref::<NodeError>() {
        nodes.push(n.node);
        cur = &*n.source;
    }
    if nodes.len() > 1 { format!("{cur}\n  (in {})", nodes.join(" > ")) } else { cur.to_string() }
}

fn get<'a, T>(slot: &'a Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<&'a T, Error> {
    slot.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Moves a value out of its slot, at its last read.
fn take_slot<T>(slot: &mut Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<T, Error> {
    slot.take().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Looks up `k`, failing if it's missing.
fn map_get<K: Ord + std::fmt::Debug, V: Clone>(m: &std::collections::BTreeMap<K, V>, k: &K) -> Result<V, Error> {
    m.get(k).cloned().ok_or_else(|| format!("key {k:?} not found").into())
}

/// Indexes `xs`, failing if `i` is out of range.
fn slice_get<E: Clone>(xs: &[E], i: &i64) -> Result<E, Error> {
    usize::try_from(*i)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| xs.get(i).cloned())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("index {i} out of range [0, {})", xs.len()).into())
}

/// Unoptimized, a proc's frame holds every node's temporaries at once, so
/// grammar-deep recursion overflows the default 2 MiB; debug builds give
/// their threads more.
fn thread_builder() -> std::thread::Builder {
    let b = std::thread::Builder::new();
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    let b = b.stack_size(64 << 20);
    b
}

/// Runs `f` over `xs` on scoped threads; results keep input order.
fn fan_out<E: Send, R: Send>(xs: Vec<E>, f: impl Fn(E) -> Result<R, Error> + Sync) -> Result<Vec<R>, Error> {
    std::thread::scope(|s| {
        let f = &f;
        let handles: Vec<_> = xs
            .into_iter()
            .map(|x| thread_builder().spawn_scoped(s, move || f(x)).expect("cannot spawn a thread"))
            .collect();
        handles
            .into_iter()
            .map(|h| h.join().unwrap_or_else(|p| std::panic::resume_unwind(p)))
            .collect()
    })
}

/// Runs proc Measure.
///
/// The area of each shape, summed, and how many there are of each kind.
pub fn run_measure(shapes: types::List<types::Shape>) -> Result<types::Report, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvMeasure::default();
    env.in_measure_measure = Some(InMeasureMeasure { shapes: shapes });
    let mut pc = PcMeasure::MeasureMeasure;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcMeasure::MeasureMeasure => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_measure_measure, "Measure.Measure")?;
                let this = types::MeasureArgs { shapes: input.shapes };
                env.in_measure_shapes = Some(InMeasureShapes { shapes: this.shapes });
                pc = PcMeasure::MeasureShapes;
                continue;
            }
            PcMeasure::MeasureShapes => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_measure_shapes, "Measure.Shapes")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::shapes(input.shapes).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure.Shapes", e.into()))?;
                let dim = this.clone();
                let results = fan_out(dim.to_vec(), |elem| run_measure_region1(env.clone(), elem))?;
                let this = types::List::from(results);
                env.in_measure_step = Some(InMeasureStep { f: types::Fold { xs: this, r: types::Report { count: 0_i64, total: 0.0_f64, kinds: types::Map::from_iter([]) }, i: 0_i64 } });
                pc = PcMeasure::MeasureStep;
                continue;
            }
            PcMeasure::MeasureStep => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_measure_step, "Measure.Step")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::step(input.f).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure.Step", e.into()))?;
                if (this.i.clone() == ((this.xs.clone()).len() as i64)) {
                    env.in_measure_id1 = Some(InMeasureId1 { value: this.r });
                    pc = PcMeasure::MeasureId1;
                    continue;
                }
                if (this.r.kinds.clone()).contains_key(&(slice_get(&this.xs.clone(), &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).kind) {
                    env.in_measure_step = Some(InMeasureStep { f: types::Fold { xs: this.xs.clone(), r: types::Report { count: (this.r.count + 1_i64), total: (this.r.total + (slice_get(&this.xs.clone(), &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).area), kinds: (this.r.kinds.clone()).merge(&types::Map::from_iter([((slice_get(&this.xs.clone(), &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).kind, (map_get(&this.r.kinds, &(slice_get(&this.xs, &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).kind).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))? + 1_i64))])) }, i: (this.i + 1_i64) } });
                    pc = PcMeasure::MeasureStep;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_measure_step = Some(InMeasureStep { f: types::Fold { xs: this.xs.clone(), r: types::Report { count: (this.r.count + 1_i64), total: (this.r.total + (slice_get(&this.xs.clone(), &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).area), kinds: (this.r.kinds).merge(&types::Map::from_iter([((slice_get(&this.xs, &this.i.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Measure", e))?).kind, 1_i64)])) }, i: (this.i + 1_i64) } });
                pc = PcMeasure::MeasureStep;
                continue;
            }
            PcMeasure::MeasureId1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_measure_id1, "Measure.id1")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Measure: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Measure: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// Runs proc Calc.
pub fn run_calc(base: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvCalc::default();
    env.in_calc_calc = Some(InCalcCalc { base: base });
    let mut pc = PcCalc::CalcCalc;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcCalc::CalcCalc => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_calc_calc, "Calc.Calc")?;
                let this = types::CalcArgs { base: input.base };
                env.in_calc_build = Some(InCalcBuild { base: this.base });
                pc = PcCalc::CalcBuild;
                continue;
            }
            PcCalc::CalcBuild => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_calc_build, "Calc.Build")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::build(input.base).map_err(|e| wrap("Calc.Build", e.into()))?;
                env.out_calc_build = Some(this.clone());
                env.in_calc_eval = Some(InCalcEval { e: types::Expr::Add(std::sync::Arc::new(types::ExprAdd { l: std::sync::Arc::new(types::Expr::Neg(std::sync::Arc::new(this))), r: std::sync::Arc::new(types::Expr::Lit(10_i64)) })), scale: 1_i64 });
                pc = PcCalc::CalcEval;
                continue;
            }
            PcCalc::CalcEval => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_calc_eval, "Calc.Eval")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::eval(input.e, input.scale).map_err(|e| wrap("Calc.Eval", e.into()))?;
                env.out_calc_eval = Some(this.clone());
                let slot_calc_build = take_slot(&mut env.out_calc_build, "Calc.Build")?;
                env.in_calc_twice = Some(InCalcEval { e: slot_calc_build, scale: 2_i64 });
                pc = PcCalc::CalcTwice;
                continue;
            }
            PcCalc::CalcTwice => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_calc_twice, "Calc.Twice")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::eval(input.e, input.scale).map_err(|e| wrap("Calc.Twice", e.into()))?;
                env.out_calc_twice = Some(this.clone());
                let slot_calc_eval = take_slot(&mut env.out_calc_eval, "Calc.Eval")?;
                let slot_calc_twice = take_slot(&mut env.out_calc_twice, "Calc.Twice")?;
                env.in_calc_total = Some(InCalcTotal { xs: types::List::from(vec![slot_calc_eval, slot_calc_twice, 100_i64]) });
                pc = PcCalc::CalcTotal;
                continue;

            PcCalc::CalcTotal => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_calc_total, "Calc.Total")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::total(input.xs).map_err(|e| wrap("Calc.Total", e.into()))?;

            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Calc: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvClassify {
    in_classify_classify: Option<InClassifyClassify>,
    out_classify_classify: Option<types::ClassifyArgs>,
    in_classify_look: Option<InClassifyLook>,
    out_classify_look: Option<types::Expr>,
    in_classify_id1: Option<InClassifyId1>,
    out_classify_id1: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_id2: Option<InClassifyId2>,
    out_classify_id2: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_id3: Option<InClassifyId3>,
    out_classify_id3: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_inner: Option<InClassifyClassify>,
    out_classify_inner: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_id4: Option<InClassifyId4>,
    out_classify_id4: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_id5: Option<InClassifyId5>,
    out_classify_id5: Option<types::Str>,
    in_classify_id6: Option<InClassifyId6>,
    out_classify_id6: Option<types::Str>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcClassify {
    ClassifyClassify,
    ClassifyLook,
    ClassifyId1,
    ClassifyId2,
    ClassifyId3,
    ClassifyInner,
    ClassifyId4,
    ClassifyId5,
    ClassifyId6,
}

/// Runs proc Classify.
///
/// Pattern switches match structure: variants, struct fields (all of them,
/// `_` for the ones that don't matter) and bindings. Conditions on values go
/// in a switch nested under a pattern arm, which sees its bindings. The
/// arms cover every Expr, so no else is needed. `id(value)` ends the proc
/// with a value.
pub fn run_classify(e: types::Expr) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvClassify::default();
    env.in_classify_classify = Some(InClassifyClassify { e: e });
    let mut pc = PcClassify::ClassifyClassify;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcClassify::ClassifyClassify => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_classify, "Classify.Classify")?;
                let this = types::ClassifyArgs { e: input.e };
                env.in_classify_look = Some(InClassifyLook { e: this.e });
                pc = PcClassify::ClassifyLook;
                continue;
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyLook => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_look, "Classify.Look")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::look(input.e).map_err(|e| wrap("Classify.Look", e.into()))?;
                if matches!((&this), types::Expr::Lit(..)) {
                    let b_n = (match (&this) { types::Expr::Lit(p) => p, _ => unreachable!() }).clone();
                    if (crate::rs::src::impls::small(b_n.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Classify.Small", e.into()))? && ((b_n.clone() % 2_i64) == 0_i64)) {
                        env.in_classify_id1 = Some(InClassifyId1 { value: types::Str::from("small even") });
                        pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId1;
                        continue;
                    }
                    env.in_classify_id2 = Some(InClassifyId2 { value: types::Str::from("literal") });
                    pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId2;
                    continue;
                }
                if matches!((&this), types::Expr::Neg(p) if matches!((&**p), types::Expr::Lit(..))) {
                    env.in_classify_id3 = Some(InClassifyId3 { value: types::Str::from("negated literal") });
                    pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId3;
                    continue;
                }
                if matches!((&this), types::Expr::Neg(..)) {
                    let b_e = (match (&this) { types::Expr::Neg(p) => &**p, _ => unreachable!() }).clone();
                    env.in_classify_inner = Some(InClassifyClassify { e: b_e });
                    pc = PcClassify::ClassifyInner;
                    continue;
                }
                if matches!((&this), types::Expr::Add(p) if (matches!((&*(&**p).l), types::Expr::Lit(..)) && matches!((&*(&**p).r), types::Expr::Lit(..)))) {
                    env.in_classify_id4 = Some(InClassifyId4 { value: types::Str::from("sum of literals") });
                    pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId4;
                    continue;
                }
                if matches!((&this), types::Expr::Add(..)) {
                    env.in_classify_id5 = Some(InClassifyId5 { value: types::Str::from("something else") });
                    pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId5;
                    continue;
                }
                return Err(format!("Classify.Look: no match arm for {:?}", this).into());
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id1, "Classify.id1")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId2 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id2, "Classify.id2")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId3 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id3, "Classify.id3")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyInner => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_inner, "Classify.Inner")?;
                let this = run_classify(input.e).map_err(|e| wrap("Classify.Inner", e.into()))?;
                env.out_classify_inner = Some(this.clone());
                let slot_classify_inner = take_slot(&mut env.out_classify_inner, "Classify.Inner")?;
                env.in_classify_id6 = Some(InClassifyId6 { value: types::Str::from(format!("{}{}", types::Str::from("minus "), slot_classify_inner)) });
                pc = PcClassify::ClassifyId6;
                continue;
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId4 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id4, "Classify.id4")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId5 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id5, "Classify.id5")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcClassify::ClassifyId6 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_classify_id6, "Classify.id6")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Classify: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

// ---- proc ForEach ----

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvForEach {
    in_for_each_for_each: Option<InForEachForEach>,
    out_for_each_for_each: Option<types::OutcomeB>,
    in_for_each_start: Option<InForEachStart>,
    out_for_each_start: Option<types::ForEachStartOut>,
    in_for_each_collect: Option<InForEachCollect>,
    out_for_each_collect: Option<i64>,
    in_for_each_process: Option<InForEachProcess>,
    out_for_each_process: Option<i64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcForEach {
    ForEachForEach,
    ForEachStart,
    ForEachCollect,
    ForEachProcess,
}

/// Runs proc ForEach.
pub fn run_for_each(i: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvForEach::default();
    env.in_for_each_for_each = Some(InForEachForEach { i: i });
    let mut pc = PcForEach::ForEachForEach;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcForEach::ForEachForEach => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_for_each_for_each, "ForEach.ForEach")?;
                let this = types::OutcomeB { i: input.i };
                env.in_for_each_start = Some(InForEachStart { i: this.i });
                pc = PcForEach::ForEachStart;
                continue;
            }
            PcForEach::ForEachStart => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_for_each_start, "ForEach.Start")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::range(input.i).map_err(|e| wrap("ForEach.Start", e.into()))?;
                env.out_for_each_start = Some(this.clone());
                let dim = get(&env.out_for_each_start, "ForEach.Start")?.l.clone();
                let results = fan_out(dim.to_vec(), |elem| run_for_each_region1(env.clone(), elem))?;
                let this = types::List::from(results);
                env.in_for_each_collect = Some(InForEachCollect { l: this });
                pc = PcForEach::ForEachCollect;
                continue;
            }
            PcForEach::ForEachCollect => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_for_each_collect, "ForEach.Collect")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::sum(input.l).map_err(|e| wrap("ForEach.Collect", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("ForEach: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// One element of the for each from ForEach.Start.
fn run_for_each_region1(mut env: EnvForEach, elem: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let this = elem;
    env.in_for_each_process = Some(InForEachProcess { i: this.clone(), l: get(&env.out_for_each_start, "ForEach.Start")?.l.clone() });
    let mut pc = PcForEach::ForEachProcess;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcForEach::ForEachProcess => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_for_each_process, "ForEach.Process")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::square(input.i, input.l).map_err(|e| wrap("ForEach.Process", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("ForEach: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

}

/// Runs proc Bar.
pub fn run_bar(a: i64, b: types::Str) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvBar::default();
    env.in_bar_bar = Some(InBarBar { a: a, b: b });
    let mut pc = PcBar::BarBar;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcBar::BarBar => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_bar, "Bar.Bar")?;
                let this = types::BarArgs { a: input.a, b: input.b };
                env.in_bar_start = Some(InBarStart { a: this.a, b: this.b });
                pc = PcBar::BarStart;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarStart => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_start, "Bar.Start")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::repeat(input.a, input.b).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.Start", e.into()))?;
                env.out_bar_start = Some(this.clone());
                env.in_bar_loop = Some(InBarLoop { s: this });
                pc = PcBar::BarLoop;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarLoop => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_loop, "Bar.Loop")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::grow(input.s).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.Loop", e.into()))?;
                if (this.clone() < 10_i64) {
                    env.in_bar_loop = Some(InBarLoop { s: get(&env.out_bar_start, "Bar.Start")?.clone() });
                    pc = PcBar::BarLoop;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_for_each = Some(InForEachForEach { i: this });
                pc = PcBar::ForEach;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::ForEach => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_for_each, "ForEach")?;
                let this = run_for_each(input.i).map_err(|e| wrap("ForEach", e.into()))?;
                if (this.clone() == 0_i64) {
                    env.in_bar_branch1 = Some(InBarBranch1 { i: this });
                    pc = PcBar::BarBranch1;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_bar_branch2_begin = Some(InBarBranch2Begin { i: this });
                pc = PcBar::BarBranch2Begin;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarBranch1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_branch1, "Bar.Branch1")?;
                let this = unimplemented_bar_branch1(input.i).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.Branch1", e.into()))?;
                env.in_bar_end = Some(InBarEnd { r: types::Outcome::I(this) });
                pc = PcBar::BarEnd;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarBranch2Begin => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_branch2_begin, "Bar.Branch2Begin")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::describe(input.i).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.Branch2Begin", e.into()))?;
                env.in_foo_call = Some(InFooCall { s: this });
                pc = PcBar::FooCall;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarEnd => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_end, "Bar.End")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::finish(input.r).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.End", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcBar::FooCall => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_foo_call, "Foo.Call")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::effects::call(input.s).map_err(|e| wrap("Foo.Call", e.into()))?;
                env.in_bar_branch2_end = Some(InBarBranch2End { i: this });
                pc = PcBar::BarBranch2End;
                continue;
            }
            PcBar::BarBranch2End => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar_branch2_end, "Bar.Branch2End")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::log(input.i).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar.Branch2End", e.into()))?;
                env.in_bar_end = Some(InBarEnd { r: types::Outcome::S });
                pc = PcBar::BarEnd;
                continue;
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Bar: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

// ---- proc Main ----

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvMain {
    in_main_main: Option<InMainMain>,
    out_main_main: Option<types::BarArgs>,
    in_main_start: Option<InMainStart>,
    out_main_start: Option<types::BarArgs>,
    in_bar: Option<InBarBar>,
    out_bar: Option<types::Str>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcMain {
    MainMain,
    MainStart,
    Bar,
}

/// Runs proc Main.
///
/// The `demo` bin's entry (vandorf.toml): `demo <a: int> <b: string>`.
pub fn run_main(a: i64, b: types::Str) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvMain::default();
    env.in_main_main = Some(InMainMain { a: a, b: b });
    let mut pc = PcMain::MainMain;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcMain::MainMain => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_main, "Main.Main")?;
                let this = types::BarArgs { a: input.a, b: input.b };
                env.in_main_start = Some(InMainStart { a: this.a, b: this.b });
                pc = PcMain::MainStart;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::MainStart => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_main_start, "Main.Start")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::args(input.a, input.b).map_err(|e| wrap("Main.Start", e.into()))?;
                env.in_bar = Some(InBarBar { a: this.a, b: this.b });
                pc = PcMain::Bar;
                continue;
            }
            PcMain::Bar => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_bar, "Bar")?;
                let this = run_bar(input.a, input.b).map_err(|e| wrap("Bar", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Main: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

// ---- proc Resolve ----

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvResolve {
    in_resolve_resolve: Option<InResolveResolve>,
    out_resolve_resolve: Option<types::ResolveArgs>,
    in_resolve_declare: Option<InResolveDeclare>,
    out_resolve_declare: Option<types::ResolveDeclareOut>,
    in_resolve_adjust: Option<InResolveAdjust>,
    out_resolve_adjust: Option<types::ResolveDeclareOut>,
    in_resolve_found: Option<InResolveFound>,
    out_resolve_found: Option<types::Str>,
    in_resolve_missing: Option<InResolveMissing>,
    out_resolve_missing: Option<types::Str>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcResolve {
    ResolveResolve,
    ResolveDeclare,
    ResolveAdjust,
    ResolveFound,
    ResolveMissing,
}

/// Runs proc Resolve.
pub fn run_resolve(names: types::List<types::Str>, query: types::Str) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvResolve::default();
    env.in_resolve_resolve = Some(InResolveResolve { names: names, query: query });
    let mut pc = PcResolve::ResolveResolve;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcResolve::ResolveResolve => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_resolve_resolve, "Resolve.Resolve")?;
                let this = types::ResolveArgs { names: input.names, query: input.query };
                env.in_resolve_declare = Some(InResolveDeclare { names: this.names, query: this.query });
                pc = PcResolve::ResolveDeclare;
                continue;
            }
            PcResolve::ResolveDeclare => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_resolve_declare, "Resolve.Declare")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::declare(input.names, input.query).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve.Declare", e.into()))?;
                env.in_resolve_adjust = Some(InResolveAdjust { scope: ((this.scope.clone()).merge(&types::Map::from_iter([(types::Str::from("len"), types::ScopeValue { slot: ((this.scope).len() as i64), kind: types::Str::from("builtin") })]))).without(&types::List::from(vec![types::Str::from("tmp")])), query: this.query });
                pc = PcResolve::ResolveAdjust;
                continue;
            }
            PcResolve::ResolveAdjust => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_resolve_adjust, "Resolve.Adjust")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::adjust(input.scope, input.query).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve.Adjust", e.into()))?;
                if (this.scope.clone()).contains_key(&this.query.clone()) {
                    env.in_resolve_found = Some(InResolveFound { name: this.query.clone(), slot: (map_get(&this.scope.clone(), &this.query.clone()).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve", e))?).slot, kind: (map_get(&this.scope.clone(), &this.query).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve", e))?).kind, total: ((this.scope).len() as i64) });
                    pc = PcResolve::ResolveFound;
                    continue;
                }
                env.in_resolve_missing = Some(InResolveMissing { name: this.query, known: (this.scope).keys().cloned().collect::<types::List<_>>() });
                pc = PcResolve::ResolveMissing;
                continue;
            }
            PcResolve::ResolveFound => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_resolve_found, "Resolve.Found")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::found(input.name, input.slot, input.kind, input.total).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve.Found", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            PcResolve::ResolveMissing => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_resolve_missing, "Resolve.Missing")?;
                let this = crate::rs::src::impls::missing(input.name, input.known).map_err(|e| wrap("Resolve.Missing", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Resolve: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// Stands in for Bar.Branch1, which names no .rs implementation. Write,
/// with its doc comment,
/// ```text
/// /// No implementation: calls a generated stub that returns an error.
/// pub fn name(i: i64) -> Result<types::Str, E>
/// ```
/// and add `= "file.rs:name"` to its declaration.
fn unimplemented_bar_branch1(_: i64) -> Result<types::Str, Error> {
    Err("Bar.Branch1 is not implemented".into())
}

use std::sync::Arc;

/// A string. Immutable, so a clone shares it.
pub type Str = Arc<str>;

/// An array. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `concat` reuses this one's
/// buffer when nothing else shares it, and copies otherwise. Derefs to a
/// slice.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct List<T>(Arc<Vec<T>>);

impl<T> Clone for List<T> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        List(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<T> Default for List<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(Vec::new()))
    }
}

impl<T> std::ops::Deref for List<T> {
    type Target = [T];
    fn deref(&self) -> &[T] {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<T> From<Vec<T>> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: Vec<T>) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v))
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> From<&[T]> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: &[T]) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v.to_vec()))
    }
}

impl<T> FromIterator<T> for List<T> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> IntoIterator for List<T> {
    type Item = T;
    type IntoIter = std::vec::IntoIter<T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

    type Item = &'a T;
    type IntoIter = std::slice::Iter<'a, T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        self.0.iter()
    }
}

impl<T: std::fmt::Debug> std::fmt::Debug for List<T> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_list().entries(self.iter()).finish()
    }

    /// This array's elements, then `other`'s. Appends in place when nothing
    /// else shares this array.
    pub fn concat(mut self, other: &List<T>) -> List<T> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend_from_slice(other);

/// A map. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `merge` and `without` change
/// this one in place when nothing else shares it, and copy otherwise.
/// Derefs to a `BTreeMap`.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct Map<K, V>(Arc<BTreeMap<K, V>>);

impl<K, V> Clone for Map<K, V> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        Map(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<K, V> Default for Map<K, V> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(BTreeMap::new()))
    }
}

impl<K, V> std::ops::Deref for Map<K, V> {
    type Target = BTreeMap<K, V>;
    fn deref(&self) -> &BTreeMap<K, V> {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<K, V> From<BTreeMap<K, V>> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from(m: BTreeMap<K, V>) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(m))
    }
}

impl<K: Ord, V> FromIterator<(K, V)> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

impl<K: Clone, V: Clone> IntoIterator for Map<K, V> {
    type Item = (K, V);
    type IntoIter = std::collections::btree_map::IntoIter<K, V>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

impl<K: std::fmt::Debug, V: std::fmt::Debug> std::fmt::Debug for Map<K, V> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        self.0.fmt(f)
    }
}

impl<K: Ord + Clone, V: Clone> Map<K, V> {
    /// This map's entries and `other`'s; `other` wins.
    pub fn merge(mut self, other: &Map<K, V>) -> Map<K, V> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend(other.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())));
        self
    }

    /// This map without `keys`.
    pub fn without(mut self, keys: &[K]) -> Map<K, V> {
        if keys.iter().any(|k| self.0.contains_key(k)) {
            let m = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0);
            for k in keys {
                m.remove(k);
            }
        }
        self
    }
}
